enrichment.headline: Moves $13,125 at Skyline High from travel and substitute funds to teacher collaboration stipends
enrichment.summary: The Measure N Commission recommends shifting $13,125.00 within Skyline High School's 2020-21 Measure N budget. The money comes from four lines (transportation costs, teacher substitutes and AC Transit/BART tickets) and goes to stipends for teachers on extended contracts for collaboration and professional development time. The request says travel, field trips, conferences and substitutes are not needed, so there is little to no impact.

enrichment.headline: Approves carryover of $30,250 in unspent 2019-20 Measure G1 funds for a district school
enrichment.summary: Through Resolution No. 2021-0193, the Board would follow the Measure G1 oversight commission's recommendation to let a school carry over unspent 2019-20 Measure G1 teacher retention and middle school improvement funds and approve its plans for them. The cumulative amount is $30,250.00. The text does not name the school.

items.group: Measure G1 Commission - February 23, 2021 - Jill Habig, Chairperson

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.sourceIssue: The title refers to "Named District and Middle Schools" (plural), but the action text refers to a single "Named District School" without naming which school or schools receive the carry-over funds.
items.title: Measure G1 Commission - 2019-2020 Carryover Funds - Named District and Middle Schools

enrichment.headline: Directs the Board secretary to cast the district's ballot in the 2021 CSBA delegate election
enrichment.summary: This resolution instructs the Board's secretary to cast the district's ballot for up to three candidates for the California School Boards Association (CSBA) 2021 Delegate Assembly, Sub-Region 7-B (Alameda County). The ballot must be returned, postmarked or emailed, on or before March 15, 2021. No cost is stated.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: 2021 California School Boards Association (CSBA) Delegate Assembly Election - Subregion 7-B (Alameda County)

enrichment.headline: Extends Anthonio's Glenview Elementary construction consulting contract by a year, to Dec. 2021
enrichment.summary: This is the fourth amendment to the district's professional services agreement with Anthonio, Inc. for the new Glenview Elementary School building project. It extends the end date from December 31, 2020 to December 31, 2021, which is 365 more days. No added money is stated, and all other terms stay the same.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
items.title: Amendment No. 4, Independent Consultant Agreement for Professional Services – Anthonio, Inc. – Glenview Elementary School New Construction Project - Division of Facilities Planning and Management

enrichment.headline: Adds commissioning services at no cost and extends Integral Group's Fremont High contract to 2021
enrichment.summary: This is the third amendment to the district's professional services agreement with The Integral Group, Inc. for the new Fremont High School building project. It adds commissioning services (checking that building systems work as designed) at no additional cost and extends the end date from December 31, 2020 to December 31, 2021, which is 365 more days.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
items.title: Amendment No. 3, Independent Consultant Agreement – Integral Group – Fremont High School New Construction Project – Division of Facilities Planning and Management

enrichment.headline: Pays Johnson Controls $113,123 to supervise fire protection installation at new Fremont High
enrichment.summary: The district would pay Johnson Controls Fire Protection, LP $113,123.00 to supervise the installing contractor for fire prevention and controls on Increments 3, 4 and 5 of the new Fremont High School building project. It covers supervision work completed after December 31, 2020, and the term runs January 1 to December 31, 2021, so it begins before this approval.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: General Services Agreement - Johnson Controls Fire Protection, LP - Fremont High School New Construction Project - Division of Facilities Planning and Management

enrichment.summary: This is the first amendment to the district's agreement with ACC Environmental Consultants, Inc. for environmental services on the new Glenview Elementary School building project. enrichment.headline: Adds $2.47M to Overaa/Tulum's construction contract for the Foster The Center central kitchen
enrichment.summary: This is the third change order to the district's lease-leaseback construction agreement with Overaa/Tulum for the new central kitchen at the Foster The Center project. It adds $2,465,319.59, raising the contract's not-to-exceed amount from $47,187,998.25 to $49,653,317.84, and extends the completion deadline to February 17, 2021. Approval depends on Change Orders No. 1 and 2 also being approved.

outcome.action: Adopted

enrichment.headline: Adds $985,871.35 to Overaa/Tulum's Foster The Center kitchen contract for schedule delay costs
enrichment.summary: This is the first change order to the district's lease-leaseback construction agreement with Overaa/Tulum for the new central kitchen at the Foster The Center project. It adds $985,871.35 for extended general conditions caused by delays tied to fire alarm scope, Health Department scope and PG&E. It raises the not-to-exceed amount from $44,844,035.00 to $45,829,906.35 and moves the deadline from August 8, 2019 to January 31, 2020.

outcome.action: Adopted

enrichment.headline: Adds $1.36M to Overaa/Tulum's Foster The Center kitchen contract for equipment, fencing and security
enrichment.summary: This is the second change order to the district's lease-leaseback construction agreement with Overaa/Tulum for the new central kitchen at the Foster The Center project. It adds $1,358,091.90 for preliminary change orders covering extra equipment and fencing requested by Nutritional Services, extended site security, and fixes for conflicts in the construction drawings. It raises the not-to-exceed amount from $45,829,906.35 to $47,187,998.25 and extends the deadline 22 days, to February 22, 2020.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
